text:
maya: quick sync — drafted PRD for structured output & tool invocation validation. posting high-level acceptance criteria + open questions. please review before EOD.

alex: ack, will skim. main ask: do we enforce strict JSON schema at server boundary or allow best-effort parsing?

ravi: leaning strict for launch, but need migration story. if model returns extra fields or variant types we should accept and ignore unknown keys.

sophia: two concerns: (1) UX for callers when validation fails — must return machine-readable error + human hint; (2) telemetry: capture invalid schema rate per model+prompt.

maya: agreed. Proposed acceptance: 1) server returns 400 with structured error object {code, field, reason, example_fix}. 2) "lenient_mode" opt-in via request flag for agents that can't update model yet.

alex: example error payload?

maya:
```json
{"error":{"code":"schema_mismatch","field":"actions[0].args.items","reason":"expected array of strings","example_fix":"wrap items in [ ... ]"}}
```

ravi: +1. Edge case: partial outputs where actions array present but truncated mid-item. return `incomplete_output` subcode and include cached prefix if available.

sophia: rollback plan for launch: 10% canary with auto-fallback to text-only mode if invalid schema rate > 0.5% over 1h.

maya: launch criteria checklist:
- PRD and spec approved by product + eng (this thread)
- integration tests: schema fuzzing, truncated token tests, version mismatch
- observability: error rate, sample storage (P0)
- docs + SDK flag for lenient mode

ravi: scope negotiation: postpone auto-rewrite suggestions (model-side repair) to Q2, ship validator + good error messages now.

alex: can we make validation configurable per-route and per-model? ops: yes config in routing layer supports per-route features.

sophia: final questions: how do we handle schema evolution? versioned schemas with `schema_version` in response metadata, and server accepts previous N versions.

maya: +1. ok I'll fold notes into PRD and ping for approvals. tagging reviewers: @alex @ravi @sophia

dev-bot: PRD created: /docs/prd/tool-invoke-validation-draft.md :white_check_mark:

alex: reviewing now. :thumbsup:
